The minimal CachyOS stage base the AgentTeams images compose: the
digest-pinned CachyOS v3 base image (pacman, v3 repo, scriptlet-sandbox
disabled) with the cachyos-base-check verification candy composed in.
Declared locally rather than importing the distro-cachyos namespace,
whose charly-marketplace candy back-references this repo's agentteams
candy via @github.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/distro-cachyos/candy/cachyos-base-check:v2026.274.2120`
